Roadmap

Goals

- G1 Safe builds: a build never destroys input, and a failed build leaves the existing output intact.
- G2 Reliable runtime: PDF builds work with the venv or a PATH WeasyPrint, and installer flags do what they say.
- G3 Profile management from the CLI: setting a default or removing a profile needs no hand-editing of config.toml.
- G4 Batch builds: build several documents in one call.
- G5 branded-pdf parity: quire does everything branded-pdf does (verbatim text, math, page breaks, per-build overrides, loud font failures), so branded-pdf can become a thin wrapper around it.

Non-goals

- Pandoc option passthrough and watch mode are out of scope for this roadmap. Windows support is deferred (see its later item), not excluded.
